parent: CIC Group, Inc. (via Nooter Construction Company)
notes: RMF Nooter (Toledo, founded 1947 as RMF Industrial Contracting) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Nooter Construction, which is held by employee-owned CIC Group of St. Louis, MO. Nooter Construction alone shows roughly 617 employees in Dec 2024 (LinkedIn-derived), and the Toledo unit's own 5500 plan had only 5-6 participants, so the bucket rests on the parent; JobsOhio lists 85 jobs retained at the site.

Founder-owned (Dave Hegemann, founded 1987, incorporated 1988) maker of Rent Manager software, HQ 9140 Waterstone Blvd, Cincinnati. Company timeline says 350 employees in 2020, matching 255 Form 5500 participants in 2019 and 177 jobs retained; it has since passed 500 (2026), but not in the grant years.

Venture-backed Columbus startup (founded 2017, HQ 111 Liberty St) whose EDGAR record is Form D equity raises, not a 10-K; about 60 employees at its Oct 2021 Series C and 158 in 2023, consistent with 133 Form 5500 participants in 2023. Acquired by Mimecast in Aug 2024, after the grant years.

Brownfield remediation developer that has cleaned up about 14 Dayton industrial sites (Howard Paper, Dayton Electroplate) with Clean Ohio and later JobsOhio revitalization grants; the 2019 appeals opinion names Michael Heitz as 50% owner but not the other half. No Form 5500, zero jobs retained, and the Lexington KY address is the LLC's mailing address; no headcount source found, so <100 is inferred from the business model.

Wauseon Machine (founded 1983 in Wauseon) is held by Cornerstone Corporation, an Ohio industrial holding company led by Peter Paras III whose plan sponsor name is Cornerstone Wauseon, Inc.; Form 5500 shows 204 participants in 2015 and 218 in 2019, BBB lists 200 employees, and JobsOhio lists 179 jobs retained. Reorganized in Nov 2025 into Integrion Automation and Steelcrest Precision.

Dayton 501(c)(4) economic development corporation formed in 1972 by city and business leaders; Form 990 revenue was $1.5M in 2020 and the Form 5500 plan had 20 participants, with a staff of about six listed today. Likely a pass-through for a Dayton site or revitalization project.

Founder-owned (Rick Hauck, 2000) Bellefontaine material-handling equipment maker; JobsOhio's June 2019 release says 25 employees with 18 new jobs planned and a $2M move into a vacant 52,399 sq ft building, which is the revitalization grant project.

parent: Vigilant, LLC dba Vigilant Technology Solutions
notes: Privately held West Chester cybersecurity firm; directories list about 39-40 employees and Form 5500 had 20 participants in 2019. No JobsOhio or REDI Cincinnati release found for the 2022-2024 grants, which total $674K, large for a company this size, so the count is unverified.

BMW Financial Services NA (US captive finance arm, Hilliard operations center, EDGAR registrant via asset-backed trusts) is wholly owned by BMW AG of Munich; BMW Group reported 154,950 employees at end of 2023. Form 5500 shows 3,134 participants at the US entity in 2023.

parent: Luminex Home Decor & Fragrance Holding Corp.
notes: Candle-lite (founded in Cincinnati in 1840, Leesburg plant) merged with PartyLite in 2016 into Luminex Home Decor & Fragrance, Cincinnati, owned by PE firms Centre Lane Partners and The Carlyle Group. Form 5500 shows 1,022 participants at Candle-lite in 2019 and JobsOhio lists 535 jobs retained; PitchBook puts Luminex at about 1,020 employees.

General Dynamics Land Systems (Sterling Heights, MI) is the GD subsidiary that operates the Lima Army Tank Plant; parent General Dynamics of Reston, VA reported more than 100,000 employees in its FY2020 10-K. The automatic site_development class is overridden because GDLS is an operating business, though the grant likely supported the Lima plant.

Cleveland tire distributor founded 1999 by the Mueller family; majority-owned by PE firm Lindsay Goldberg from Dec 2014, then Bain Capital Private Equity from Dec 2018 (deal valued above $2B). Form 5500 shows 1,520 participants in 2019 and PitchBook lists about 1,583 employees; the 2023 jump to 10,179 participants reflects later acquisitions.

parent: Fulton County Processing, Ltd. (three-way JV incl. Heidtman Steel; Heidtman sole owner since June 2022)
notes: Delta steel pickling and slitting toll processor founded 2001; during the grant years it was a three-way joint venture with Toledo-based Heidtman Steel holding one-third since 2006, and Heidtman bought out the other partners in June 2022. Form 5500 shows 119 participants and JobsOhio 127 jobs retained; the automatic government class is wrong, this is a for-profit LLC. If rolled up to Heidtman (700+ employees) the bucket would be 500-4999.

Project LLC for the redevelopment of the former GM Moraine paint building (392,800 sq ft) in Progress Park, a joint venture of Industrial Realty Group (Stuart Lichter, Los Angeles; Ohio office in Richfield) and Industrial Commercial Properties (Cleveland), backed by a JobsOhio spec-building grant in 2023. IRG itself is a small real-estate staff (directories list 25 to 51-200 employees) managing 100M+ sq ft.

Cleveland Warehouse District call center (1500 W 3rd St) is the Ohio arm of S&P Data, a privately held Toronto-based contact-center group; directories put the group at roughly 1,075-1,319 employees and the Cleveland site at about 400, with JobsOhio listing 122 jobs retained. No Form 5500 for the Ohio LLC and no JobsOhio release found.

Public company (NYSE: KR) headquartered in Cincinnati since 1883; the 10-K for the year ended Feb 2, 2019 reports about 453,000 full- and part-time employees, and Form 5500 shows 227,916 participants in 2019. Grants over 2018-2023 total $650K against a $1.2M commitment.

Family-owned CNC aerospace machine shop (Ribic family, founded 1992, Willoughby since 2003); Team NEO's Oct 2018 release covers a $3.6M expansion retaining 38 jobs and adding 38, and Crain's put the headcount at about 50. Form 5500 shows 57 participants in 2019.

Booz Allen Hamilton Inc. is the operating subsidiary of public Booz Allen Hamilton Holding Corp (NYSE: BAH), McLean, VA; the FY2020 10-K reports about 27,200 employees as of March 31, 2020. Form 5500 shows 69,557 participants in 2019 and JobsOhio lists 290 jobs retained in Ohio (Dayton/Beavercreek area).

Municipal government; the city's 2020 Annual Information Statement reports 2,680 full- and part-time employees as of Sept 15, 2020. The specific 2020 JobsOhio project for the $650K was not identified, likely a site or infrastructure grant passed through the city.

Employee-owned Cincinnati (Blue Ash) IT and management consulting B Corp founded 2011; Form 5500 shows 117 participants in 2019, up from 36 in 2015, and JobsOhio lists 89 jobs retained. Headcount sits near the 100 line, so the bucket could be <100 if the plan count includes many former staff.
